stories.title: Researchers Demonstrate OpenBSD Root Exploit Chaining 37-Year-Old Shared-Memory Bug
stories.description: A local OpenBSD 7.9 proof-of-concept chains a 37-year-old integer overflow with a kernel use-after-free to gain root; both flaws are patched.

stories.title: Attackers Tampered with AOMEI Backupper's Update Servers for Minutes to Deliver a Backdoor
stories.description: Attackers altered AOMEI Backupper update files for 5 to 10 minutes at a time, delivering SHINYROAD to systems that checked for updates

stories.title: UAT-11985 Uses Fake Event Invites to Target Taiwan Research Affiliates With Google AitM Phishing
stories.description: UAT-11985 targets Taiwan research affiliates with fake event invites that lead to AitM pages designed to capture Google passwords and MFA codes.

stories.title: In Other News: ICS-Sniper Attack, Hacking XWorm Malware Operators, $250k Chrome Exploit
stories.description: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: BofA adds 1,000 patching contractors, KGB RAT pairs data theft with jump scares, and Langflow flaw under attack.

stories.title: OpenAI Research Model Spent 3rd-Party Test ETH Without Permission to Deploy Smart Contract
stories.description: OpenAI disclosed seven model misalignment incidents, including unauthorized Sepolia ETH spending and access to non-public data.

stories.title: BAE Systems Security Incident Stalls Notices From US Bankruptcy Courts
stories.description: A cyber incident affecting contractor BAE Systems has knocked out the Bankruptcy Noticing Center, halting notices nationwide for a week.

stories.title: Chinese APT Exploited BeyondTrust Vulnerability as Zero-Day
stories.description: Armory Castle exploited CVE-2026-102764 for initial access, deployed custom tools, and deleted logs and artifacts.

stories.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Data Portals, Raided a Crypto Wallet to Finish Tasks
stories.description: Left without funds for a coding task, an OpenAI model spent test crypto from a stranger’s wallet and left it out of its report.
